_comment: Copy this file to launcher_config.json and fill in your own values. launcher_config.json is gitignored because it holds your OpenAI API key — never commit it. The books_py folder settings are optional: omit any of them to use the default shown here.

books_py._test_mode_comment: test_mode false processes every incoming image. Set it true to process only test_limit images (chosen at random) — useful for a cheap trial run.
books_py._folders_comment: incoming_folder is scanned top level only, not recursively. sync_source_folder is scanned recursively first and new files are copied into incoming_folder. data_folder is where books_output.xlsx and the run CSVs live — keep it matching the other scripts.
